headline: As Soon as It Is Listed, JIO Will Become India's Fourth-Largest Company, Leaving Giants Like TCS, SBI and LIC Behind - mukesh ambani jio will become india fourthlargest company after listing surpass tcs sbi lic
summary: Reliance's Jio Platforms IPO will open on October 21 and close on October 23. The offering could become India's largest IPO, and Jio would become the country's fourth-largest company after listing.
why: Jio Platforms is the telecom and digital unit of Reliance Industries, India's largest listed private company, so its listing would be a major test of India's equity capital markets.
